summary.text: Beth Billings is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 56, representing St. Charles and St. John the Baptist, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2023 as the year elected.

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Beth Billings's occupation as Former small business owner.
It lists Beth Billings's education as Raleigh-Egypt High School; Legal Studies, Paralegalism, Tulane School of Professional Studies.

The House member page lists Beth Billings's committee assignments as House and Governmental Affairs; Municipal, Parochial and Cultural Affairs; Ways and Means; Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay; Legislative Budgetary Control Council; House Select Committee on Women and Children.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation; Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus; Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation.
